name: abc-anti-bribery
display_name: Anti-Bribery & Corruption — UKBA, FCPA, UNCAC & OECD
description: Structured knowledge graph for anti-bribery and corruption (ABC) compliance. Covers UK Bribery Act 2010 (Sections 1/2/6/7 and the adequate procedures defence), US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act 1977 (anti-bribery + accounting provisions), OECD Anti-Bribery Convention, UNCAC, and the proposed EU Anti-Corruption Directive. Includes ISO 37001, the Six Principles, third-party due diligence, gifts & hospitality, DPAs, self-reporting, and cross-references to AMLR, FATF, CSRD, and sanctions.
author: Futurechain FCP Team
